scope: Independent review of commits dfa74dc0 and 4540020c for guest Scrape image/video editing T10/T11/T12. Review only; no product or test edits.

previous_finding.finding: The original image removal assertions did not prove that unrelated images survive a removal.
previous_finding.evidence: The component test clicks a rendered Remove image control and asserts the exact two retained image URLs, then checks the count changed from 3 to 2. The store test also asserts exact video survivor identity. Independent scoped run passed.

A_behavior_evidence_scope.evidence: The component test mounts actual ScrapeView and real Zustand store. Rendered media tabs, AddItemRow controls, image/video row controls, and CopyButton are active; clicking them changes the store and rendered image count. The video anchor exposes the captured URL, and CopyButton passes its URL to a mocked clipboard boundary. Page identity/recognition, organization, unrelated panels, clipboard I/O, capture/save actions are stubbed or outside the exercised scope.
A_behavior_evidence_scope.limit: This establishes source/component behavior in Vitest only. It does not establish browser tab launch, native extension behavior, or real clipboard I/O.

B_test_quality.evidence: The real store owns media mutations; the UI test's useScrape mock delegates current/edited/mark actions to that store, while ScrapeView directly selects real media mutators. User-facing controls drive those mutators. Assertions check exact retained identities, additions, blank-input state, cancel reset, link href, clipboard argument, and image count. The selected-image removal is forced by exact survivor identity; a wrong-row removal diverges. No mocks replace media mutations or AddItemRow/CopyButton logic.
B_test_quality.limitation: The checked report records a remove-all mutation failure for the state test. This peer review did not rerun a mutant or native/browser acceptance; green tests alone are not end-to-end verification.
